verdict.rationale: Muse's evidence describes single-goal/task assistance (subscriptions, budgets, fitness plans, email) and explicitly gates its API/MCP surface behind auth (401s/404s), leaving no documented capability for issuing or managing bulk/batch operations across many items programmatically. missing for 10: any mention of batch/bulk task execution, multi-item processing API, or CSV/list-based operation, and a public developer surface to invoke it at scale.
